stats.title: Statistics
stats.intro: How the channel posts and how it gets read, from the posts held here. Clock-shaped figures use the channel's own time zone.
stats.calendarHint: One square per day. Darker means more posts.
stats.weekdayHourHint: Weekday against hour, in the channel's own time zone.
stats.sourcesHint: External domains the channel sends readers to.
stats.afterIndexingIntro: These come from reading every post, not from counting them — which is why a follower-count service cannot show them.
stats.pending: Waiting on indexing. {done} of {total} posts read so far; this fills in as extraction completes.
stats.themeDrift: What it covered, year by year
stats.themeDriftHint: Each band is a theme; the width is its share of that quarter.

tags.title: The index
tags.intro: Every post is filed under the subjects it covers and the people, bodies and places it names. These groups were built from the channel's own history.
tags.empty: Nothing filed under this group yet.

graph.title: The map
graph.intro: Every post is a dot and every subject a hub. A post links to what it is about, to the post it replied to, and to the posts it cites. Drag, zoom, and click a subject to rebuild the map around it.
graph.hint: Click a subject to see its posts; double-click to filter the map by it.
graph.truncated: Only the newest {count} posts of this period are drawn; narrow the range to see all of them.

archive.title: Posts
archive.emptyBody: Posts appear as soon as the channel history is imported.

landing.metaTitle: Osor — a website for your Telegram channel
landing.metaDescription: We turn your channel's whole archive into a site on your own domain: search, tags, statistics and questions to the archive.
landing.lead: Osor turns a channel's entire history into a site on your own domain. Every post is read and tagged by topic, person and institution. Readers search it, filter it and ask it questions.
landing.bookBody: On Telegram a post is read for a few days and then sinks down the feed. On Osor your channel's whole history becomes one work, with a table of contents, an index and chapters. It is like publishing the years you have written as a book.
landing.bookTg1: A post lives for two or three days, then gets buried in the feed.
landing.bookTg2: Finding a post from three years ago means scrolling for months.
landing.bookTg3: Neither Google nor anyone who isn't subscribed can find it.
landing.bookTg4: Topics, people, storylines: no order at all.
landing.bookOsor1: Every post is its own page with a permanent address.
landing.bookOsor2: A table of contents: an index of topics and people.
landing.bookOsor3: Chapters: posts that continue each other become stories.
landing.bookOsor4: Search engines find it, and readers ask questions and get answers.
landing.f1t: A site on your own domain
landing.f1b: Every post gets its own page, with photos, links and reactions. Search engines find it too.
landing.f2t: An index of topics and people
landing.f2b: AI reads every post: who, which institutions, which topics. It all comes together on tag pages.
landing.f3t: Search in Latin, Cyrillic and Russian
landing.f3b: Searching “Toshkent” also finds posts about “Тошкент”. Filter by period, type and topic.
landing.f4b: A reader asks, and the answer comes with links to the channel's own posts. Nothing made up.
landing.f5b: See how topics connect on a map, and follow posts that continue each other as stories.
landing.f6b: When the channel posts, what it covers most, which sources it relies on — on one page.
landing.s1b: Collect topics and see what is in draft and what is scheduled.
landing.s2b: The assistant learns your style from past posts and takes facts from the archive.
landing.s3b: “When did I write about this?” — answered with sources.
landing.s4b: Posts go out through your channel's bot at the time you set.
landing.studioNote: The studio is open only to the channel's owner, so these links ask you to sign in with Telegram.
landing.p1b: Sign in with Telegram and add your channel link; the price shows right there.
landing.p2b: The whole history is imported, indexed and tagged.
landing.p3b: On your domain: a site for readers and a studio for you.
landing.finalBody: Sign in with Telegram and add your channel link: size, price and plan on one page.
landing.pricingBody: The import is priced by the size of the channel: {posts} posts come to about {price} UZS, for example. After that, a monthly fee for the plan you choose. Paste your channel link and see the exact price in a minute.
